Filmmaker R. Sarath, known for environmental themes, dies at 65

Filmmaker R. Sarath, who was 65 years old, has died in Thiruvananthapuram. He was recognized for his contemplative cinema that often addressed environmental concerns. Sarath was an award-winning director from Kerala.
